## F — Vehicle emergencies and crash responsibilities
Research index: 31 original C facts and 18 continuation or confusable C2 facts cover Vehicle emergencies and crash responsibilities.
Exam index: part A cites cover edition, publisher frontmatter and the physical testing page; no passing percentage or time limit is asserted.
VERIFY: ID-EMERGENCIES-PERCENT — official percentage not printed; ID-EMERGENCIES-TIME — official time limit unlocated; ID-EMERGENCIES-EFFECTIVE — effective date unestablished.
VERIFY: ID-EMERGENCIES-DYNAMIC — Current crash-reporting thresholds, liability protections, uninsured-driver procedures and vehicle-specific emergency instructions require current official or manufacturer verification before release.
VERIFY: ID-EMERGENCIES-MARKET — demand research missing; ID-EMERGENCIES-COMPETITORS — competitor research missing.
Every open item stays assigned to the evidence or research owner in its originating chunk. Pedagogic priorities are not official topic weights.
VERIFY: ID-NONABS-BRAKING-CONFLICT — Physical page one hundred seventeen directs hard braking short of lockup, release if locked and reapplication after skidding ends; one hundred eighteen instead broadly says pump hard and fast. The specific lockup-response procedure is covered, but the broader conflicting prescription is withheld pending vehicle-safety review.
VERIFY: ID-ABS-STOPPING-UNIVERSAL — Physical page one hundred sixteen says ABS does not decrease stopping distance and describes full steering control. These statements are not generalized into universal performance guarantees across surfaces and vehicles; retain manufacturer-specific review.
VERIFY: ID-EMERGENCY-CLINICAL-LEGAL-REVIEW — Crash injury handling, collision-positioning advice, emergency scene exposure and legal liability in these pages have not completed the reserved clinical/legal review. Source reading is not that independent gate; relevant instructions remain blocked for release until the review artifact exists.
VERIFY: ID-CRASH-POSITIONING-REVIEW — The headrest-pressure and front-impact face-protection instructions on physical page one hundred eighteen require current vehicle/airbag and clinical review. The arms-and-hands face instruction is withheld; no universal occupant-position prescription is inferred.
VERIFY: ID-CRASH-REPORT-THRESHOLD-CURRENCY — Physical pages one hundred nineteen and one hundred twenty-one give a property-damage threshold above fifteen hundred dollars, or injury, for police notification. The source amount and strict inequality are preserved, but present legal currency remains unverified and blocks release of a current-law claim.
VERIFY: ID-GOOD-SAMARITAN-SCOPE — Physical page one hundred twenty-one summarizes good-faith civil-liability protection without the complete statute or exceptions. No blanket immunity guarantee is taught; the legal scope requires the reserved review.
VERIFY: ID-UNINSURED-JUDGMENT-DURATION — Physical page one hundred nineteen links an uninsured driver's possible suspension to payment or up to six years. The relation of those endpoints and current department procedure are not resolved by the paragraph. Do not invent a definite duration or guaranteed collection outcome.
VERIFY: ID-STRANDING-MORTALITY-RANK — The most-deaths claim for people leaving cars in heavy snow on physical page one hundred fifteen lacks a dated study and is withheld; the conditional stay-with-vehicle instruction is retained.
